book.subject: english
book.note: 单元目录与语法分布对照2024新教材课本目录与Grammar课件核实（U6=动词及基本句型I 主谓/主谓宾/主系表，U7=动词及基本句型II 双宾语与宾补）；词表与易错点参考教师整理笔记（小红书/学科网/21世纪教育网公开资料），开学后建议对照课本 Wordlist 微调。

units.title: Friendship

core_vocab.cn: 感到厌倦的（人）；boring 令人厌倦的（物）
感觉；理解力（a sense of humour）

grammar.name: 形容词的比较级与最高级
key_points: 规则变化：一般加 -er/-est；以 e 结尾加 -r/-st；辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i；重读闭音节双写尾字母；多音节词前加 more/most
不规则变化：good/well→better→best；bad/badly→worse→worst；many/much→more→most；little→less→least；far→farther/further
程度修饰：比较级前可加 much / a lot / a little / even / far（如 a lot hotter）
句型：the + 比较级 + of the two（两者中更……的）；比较级 + and + 比较级（越来越……）；the + 比较级..., the + 比较级...（越……越……）
最高级：the + 最高级 + in/of + 范围
examples: Max is the tallest boy in our class.
A good friend makes you happier.
Amy is the shorter of the twin sisters.

sentence_patterns: What's your friend like? — He is kind and friendly.
She is always ready to help people in need.
Who would you choose as your best friend?
units.writing_topic: My best friend（外貌+性格+一件体现品质的小事）
exam_focus: 词形转换：happy→happier→happiest，heavy→heavier 等辅音+y 变化最容易考
选择填空高频：the + 比较级 of the two；much/a lot 修饰比较级
bored（人感到无聊）vs boring（令人无聊）：I'm bored with the boring film.
lie 两义：撒谎 lied-lied-lying；躺 lay-lain-lying
比较句中 that/those 替代：The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai.

tips.text: 早读：用5个形容词口头描述你的好朋友，每个词配一句例子。
辅音字母+y结尾的形容词变比较级：happy→happier，heavy→heavier，easy→easier。
不规则变化记牢：good/well→better→best；bad→worse→worst；far→farther/further。
比较级前能加 much/a lot/even/far，但不能加 very。very taller ✗ → much taller ✓
两者中更……的那个：the + 比较级 + of the two。He is the taller of the two boys.
睡前自测：写出 taller / nicer / bigger / heavier / more helpful 的原级。
encourage 用法：encourage sb to do sth。My friends encourage me to try new things.
写朋友作文三段式：外貌→性格品质→用一件小事证明（one thing he/she did）。
睡前大声朗读今天课文段落5分钟，练语感比默背更省力。
越……越……：the + 比较级, the + 比较级。The more, the better.
-ed 修饰人，-ing 修饰物：I feel bored. / The film is boring。一组记透：excited/exciting。
比较对象要对等，用 that/those 替代：The air here is cleaner than that in my hometown.
make sb do 不带 to：The joke made everyone laugh. 不是 made everyone to laugh。

units.title: School life

core_vocab.cn: 提供；主动提出（offer to do）

key_phrases.cn: 比……更多/更少（可数/不可数）

key_phrases.en: the most / the fewest / the least
spend time on sth / (in) doing sth
key_phrases.cn: 花时间在某事/做某事上
期待（做）某事（to 是介词！）

grammar.name: 数量的比较（more/fewer/less）与原级比较（as...as）
key_points: 可数名词复数用 more/fewer：more books, fewer clubs
不可数名词用 more/less：more time, less homework
最高级：the most / the fewest / the least
as + 原级 + as：和……一样；否定 not as/so + 原级 + as：不如……
同义转换：not as...as = less...than
examples: Our school has fewer students than theirs.
I spend less time on homework than you.
Millie is not as tall as Amy.

sentence_patterns: Which subject do you like best?
My school life is as colourful as yours.
We have more after-school activities this term.
units.writing_topic: My ideal school / My school life（作息、课程、社团、与旧学校比较）
exam_focus: fewer 修饰可数、less 修饰不可数——单选必考
as...as 中间用原级：as tall as，不能说 as taller as
few（几乎没有，否定）vs a few（有几个，肯定）；little / a little 同理（修饰不可数）
look forward to 中 to 是介词：look forward to seeing you（不是 to see）

tips.text: fewer + 可数复数（fewer books），less + 不可数（less water），别混。
as...as 中间永远用原级：as interesting as。not as/so...as = 不如。
早读时比较两门科目：I have more fun in English than in ... 造两句。
spend 的搭配：spend + 时间/钱 + on sth / (in) doing sth。
同义句转换常考：not as...as = less...than。He is less careful than me. = He is not as careful as me.
睡前自测：more / fewer / less 各造一句，检查名词是否可数。
最高级三个搭配：the most + 名词（不可数）、the fewest + 可数复数、the least + 不可数。
写理想学校至少用两次比较：more outdoor activities, less homework。
睡前把今天错的1道题讲给自己听一遍，能讲清才是真懂。
activity 复数 activities；discuss 后直接接宾语，不加 about。
look forward to + doing：I look forward to hearing from you. to 是介词，后面跟动名词。
few = 几乎没有（否定）；a few = 有几个（肯定）。There is little water = 没多少水了。
offer 双用法：offer sb sth = offer sth to sb；offer to do 主动提出做某事。

units.title: To be a good learner

grammar.name: 副词的比较级与最高级；反身代词
key_points: 副词比较级：harder, faster, earlier, more slowly, more carefully
不规则：well→better→best；badly→worse→worst；far→farther/further
最高级前 the 可省略（副词最高级）：He runs (the) fastest in our class.
反身代词：myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves
常见搭配：enjoy oneself / by oneself / help yourself (to) / teach oneself / hurt oneself
反身代词不能单独作主语：Myself did it ✗
examples: Kitty dances better than Simon.
He did the experiment by himself.
Help yourself to some fish.

sentence_patterns: The more you read, the more you know.
I made great progress by reviewing every day.
We should pay attention to the details.
units.writing_topic: How to be a good learner（2-3条方法+具体例子）
exam_focus: 区分形容词/副词：认真地 carefully（副词）vs 认真的 careful（形容词）
反身代词与主语对应：主语是 we → ourselves

tips.text: 副词比较级：quickly→more quickly，early→earlier。well→better→best 是最高频考点。
修饰动词用副词：He studies hard.（不是 hardly！hardly=几乎不）
反身代词搭配：enjoy oneself 玩得开心，by oneself 独自，teach oneself 自学。
早读用『3-2-1』：今天要记3个词、2个短语、1个句型，写在本子上。
the + 比较级, the + 比较级：The more carefully you write, the fewer mistakes you make.
睡前闭眼过一遍今天课堂流程，用英语说出3个记住的词或句。
progress 不可数：make great progress ✓，a progress ✗
学习方法作文套路：总起→方法1+例子→方法2+例子→总结，用上 by oneself 和 make progress。
睡前把明天要交的作业核对一遍，减少早上慌乱——好学习者赢在前一晚。
副词最高级的 the 可省：She sings (the) best in our class.

units.title: Hands-on fun
units.topic_cn: 动手乐趣：DIY 与建议表达

grammar.name: 祈使句；should 与 had better
key_points: 肯定祈使句：以动词原形开头。Cut the paper into pieces.
否定祈使句：Don't + 动词原形。Don't touch the wet paint.
Let's + 动词原形（包括说话人在内的建议）：Let's make a card for Mum.
should (not) do：建议、义务，语气一般
had better (not) do：劝告、提醒，语气更强，常指当下最好这样做；否定是 had better not do
祈使句 + and/or + 将来结果：Work hard, and you will pass.
examples: Read the instructions carefully before you start.
You'd better not paint the wall without help.
Don't be late for the DIY class.

sentence_patterns: First ... Next ... Then ... Finally ...（描述制作步骤）
You'd better read the instructions first.
What did you make by yourself?
units.writing_topic: A DIY experience（用 First/Next/Then/Finally 写清步骤，加一次失败或成功）
exam_focus: had better 后接动词原形，否定 had better not do（不是 don't）
祈使句的反意疑问用 will you：Don't be late, will you?

tips.text: 祈使句 = 动词原形开头。否定加 Don't：Don't cut your fingers!
had better not do（否定直接跟 not）：You'd better not touch it. 不是 had not better。
祈使句 + and/or：Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus. Work hard, and you'll make it.
早读认工具词：scissors（复数形式）、glue、tape、brush、tool——默写一遍。
instead of + doing：He watched TV instead of doing homework. instead 后接句子时单独用。
睡前口头说一遍泡面/冲牛奶的4个步骤，全用祈使句。
Let's ... 的反意疑问用 shall we：Let's start, shall we?
步骤作文四件套：First / Next / Then / Finally，评委老师最爱看顺序词。
睡前用英语给家人下3个『指令』（Open the door...），练祈使句语感。
建议三选一练表达：You should... / You'd better... / Don't... 各说一句。

units.title: Wild animals

key_phrases.en: make an effort to do sth

grammar.name: 动词不定式（作宾语、目的状语、形式主语）
key_points: 常见接不定式作宾语的动词：want, hope, decide, plan, agree, refuse, manage, learn
否定：decide not to do
目的状语：to do / in order to do（为了……），可放句首或句尾
It is + adj + for/of sb + to do：for 的形容词描述事物（important, necessary, difficult）；of 的形容词描述人的品质（kind, nice, clever, brave）
疑问词 + to do：She doesn't know how to solve it.
不定式作宾补：ask/tell/invite sb (not) to do sth
remember/forget + to do（未做）vs doing（已做）
examples: It is important for us to protect wild animals.
It is kind of you to help me.
Pandas are losing their homes, so we must act to help them.

sentence_patterns: If we don't protect them, they may disappear forever.
They are facing serious problems in the wild.
Everyone should take action to save them.
units.writing_topic: Protecting wild animals（现状→原因→呼吁，用上 It is important to...）
exam_focus: It is + adj + for/of sb 的选择：形容词形容人用 of
stop/keep/prevent ... from doing 的搭配区别

tips.text: It is + adj + for sb to do：形容词说事情（important/difficult）；of sb：形容词说人品（kind/clever）。
enjoy 后接 doing 不接 to do：He enjoys swimming ✓ enjoys to swim ✗
remember/forget to do = 忘记去做（还没做）；remember/forget doing = 记得做过（已做）。
早读动物词 + 保护词各5个：panda, whale, wolf...；protect, danger, hunt...
weigh 是动词『重达』，weight 是名词。It weighs 100 kilos. / its weight。
睡前用 to do 造3句：want to / decide to / in order to 各一句。
目的状语两种写法：To save time, ... = In order to save time, ...（放句首时 in order to 更正式）。
动物保护作文：现状（in danger）→原因（hunt/lose homes）→措施（take action to protect）→呼吁。
睡前把今天课文里所有 to do 短语圈出来，想想每个不定式充当什么成分。
manage to do = 设法做成；try to do = 努力做（不一定成功）。

units.title: Seasons

grammar.name: 动词及基本句型（I）：行为动词与连系动词（S+V / S+V+O / S+V+P）
key_points: 行为动词分及物/不及物：不及物动词意义完整，不接宾语（The sun rises.）；及物动词必须接宾语（S+V+O：We study English.）
不及物动词接宾语要加介词：arrive in Beijing（不能说 arrive Beijing）
连系动词后接表语，构成主系表 S+V+P：be 类；变化类 become/get/turn/grow；感官类 look/sound/smell/taste/feel；保持类 keep/stay/remain
表语用名词、形容词或介词短语，不能用副词：He looks happy ✓（不是 happily）
同形词要辨析：She looks tired.（连系动词，看起来）vs She looks at the picture.（实义动词，看）
examples: The sky is blue. / The leaves turn yellow.（S+V+P）
Kitty will watch a film this Sunday.（S+V+O）
Dinner smells good.（S+V+P）

sentence_patterns: It is sunny and warm in spring.
The leaves turn yellow and red in autumn.
Which season do you like best? Why?
units.writing_topic: My favourite season（天气、景色、活动、感受，用上比较级）
exam_focus: 天气名词→形容词：fog→foggy, snow→snowy, sun→sunny（双写 n）
句子结构判断：The wind is blowing hard. 属于 S+V（blow 不及物）——期末句型判断高频
系动词后接形容词不接副词：He looks happily ✗ → He looks happy ✓

tips.text: 天气形容词规律：名词+双y：sun→sunny, fog→foggy；snow→snowy 直接+y。
turn/get/become 后接形容词：The weather gets colder. 不是 more cold。
早读用三句话播报今天天气：It is ... The temperature is ... Don't forget your ...
be covered with：The ground is covered with snow. 不是 covers。
smell/sound/look 是系动词，后面接形容词：The flowers smell sweet. 不是 sweetly。
睡前默写四季名 + 每季1个形容词 + 1个活动短语。
季节作文五感法：看（leaves turn red）、听（wind blows）、闻（flowers smell sweet）、做（fly kites）、感受（I feel relaxed）。
判断句型三步：动词后没宾语→S+V；接了宾语→S+V+O；连系动词+形容词/名词→S+V+P。
睡前朗读本单元诗歌体课文一遍，注意节奏和押韵。
temperature 搭配：The temperature stays around 10 degrees. 度数用 degree。

units.title: The natural world

key_phrases.en: provide sb with sth / provide sth for sb
play a part in doing sth

grammar.name: 动词及基本句型（II）：双宾语（S+V+IO+DO）与宾语补足语（S+V+DO+OC）
key_points: 双宾语：give/show/tell/teach/send sb sth = give/show/... sth to sb；buy/make/cook/get sb sth = ... sth for sb
The sun gives us light and heat. = The sun gives light and heat to us.
宾语补足语：call/name sb sth（We call the ocean the 'heart' of the earth.）；keep + 宾语 + adj；ask/tell sb (not) to do
if/unless 条件状语从句在单元语篇中高频出现（If we protect nature, we protect ourselves.），中考考『主将从现』
examples: If we protect nature, we protect ourselves.
Plastic waste is harmful to ocean animals.
Pollution leads to serious health problems.

sentence_patterns: The ocean provides us with food and oxygen.
Everyone can play a part in saving the natural world.
It's our duty to protect the environment.
units.writing_topic: How to protect the natural world（问题→措施，用 if 句式串联）
exam_focus: 双宾语介词：give/show sth to sb，但 buy/make sth for sb——单选高频
宾补：We call him 'Uncle Wang'. / keep the door open
if 条件句时态：主将从现，从句绝不用 will
provide sb with sth / provide sth for sb 的介词搭配

tips.text: 主将从现！If it rains tomorrow（不是 will rain），we will cancel the trip。
unless = if ... not：Unless we act now, ... = If we don't act now, ...
provide 双介词：provide us with food = provide food for us。
早读造3个 if 句：If I ..., I will ... 每句主句必须用 will。
be harmful to 中介词用 to：Plastic is harmful to sea animals。
give sb sth = give sth to sb；但 make/buy 用 for：buy sth for sb。
睡前判断：If he will come... 对吗？——错，改成 If he comes。
环保作文用 if 串联措施：If we plant more trees, the air will be cleaner. If we use less plastic, ...
睡前检查今天有没有把 if 从句写成将来时——这是全单元第一大坑。
词族记忆：pollute→pollution→polluted；protect→protection。
双宾语两句型：give me some food = give some food to me；buy me flowers = buy flowers for me。
宾补结构：We call the ocean the 'heart' of the earth. call sb sth 称某人是……。

units.title: Safe and sound

grammar.name: 过去进行时（was/were + doing）；when/while/as
key_points: 结构：was/were + v-ing，表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作
否定：was/were not + doing；疑问：Was/Were + 主语 + doing?
常见时间状语：at 8:00 p.m. yesterday, at that time, from 7 to 8 last night
when + 短暂动作（一般过去时）：The earthquake started when we were having class.
while + 持续动作（常接进行时）：I was reading while he was watching TV.
as = 当……时，可与 when 换用
examples: Mr. Smith was watching TV at 8:00 p.m. last night.
The ground started to shake while people were running.
When the earthquake hit, he was doing the dishes.

sentence_patterns: I was doing my homework when the lights went out.
People were running in all directions in fear.
Keep calm and stay away from the windows.
units.writing_topic: A natural disaster I experienced/heard about（过去进行时描述当时场景+安全建议）
exam_focus: when（短暂动作用过去时）与 while（持续动作用进行时）的选择
过去进行时与一般过去时的区分：正在做（进行）vs 做了（过去）

tips.text: 过去进行时 = was/were + doing：I was doing my homework at 8 last night。
when 接短暂动作（一般过去时），while 接持续动作（进行时）：When he came in, I was reading.
过去进行时不能忘 be 动词：I doing ✗ → I was doing ✓
早读自述：昨晚8点家里每个人在干什么，全部用过去进行时说一遍。
while 也可表对比『然而』：I like maths while my brother likes art。
词形：silence n.→silent adj.；safety n.→safe adj.；suddenly adv.→sudden adj.
睡前把 yesterday evening 6点到9点的时间轴用3句过去进行时说出来。
灾害作文结构：当时我正在……（过去进行时）→突然……（一般过去时）→自救建议（祈使句）。正好串起本册三大语法！
期末临近：睡前翻一遍本学期错题本，只看红笔订正的部分。
as ... as possible：as quickly as possible 尽快；as soon as possible 尽早。
